body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself. Gain +1 Defense until your next turn; one ally within 4 units may gain +1 Defense if it moves adjacent to you.

surges.html: You may suffer -1 Defense until your next turn; if you do, one affected ally becomes Rallied.
If an affected ally is already Rallied, it gains +1 Defense until its next turn instead.

rider.title: EXAMPLE — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority after you move toward an enemy or objective: 1–3 one ally may move 1 unit; 4–5 two allies may move 1 unit; 6+ one of them also becomes Rallied.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
